parts:
I m getting the below error in red while executing the RHIPE test code from the pdf.

I have tried the options mentioned in earlier post, but it did not provide and success.

I m relatively new to R and RHIPE anticipating you replies


rhwrite(list(1,2,3),"/tmp/x")

rhread("/tmp/x")


map <- expression({
  lapply(seq_along(map.values),function(r){
    x <- runif(map.values[[r]])
    rhcollect(map.keys[[r]],c(n=map.values[[r]],mean=mean(x),sd=sd(x)))
  })
})
## Create a job object
z <- rhmr(map, ofolder="/tmp/test", inout=c('lapply','sequence'),N=10,
          mapred=list(mapred.reduce.tasks=0),jobname='test')
## Submit the job
rhex(z)
## Read the results
res <- rhread('/tmp/test/p*')
